text.en:
Grants stacks of 'Reaper's Tithe' based on the number of simultaneously killed enemies. Maximum of 3 stacks.

'Reaper's Tithe' grants 20%|30%|40% increased damage for #e${15+#d} seconds. Timer only start after firing.

Additional Weapon Kills extend the buff duration by 6 seconds, but not beyond the initial #e${15+#d}-second duration.

Scoring a higher number of simultaneous Kills than the currently active stack count will not "upgrade" the buff.

enhanced (
var d = 2
#e Buff duration is increased by 2 seconds.
)
